sentences.sk: Dnes je teplé popoludnie a Nina má voľno.
sentences.en: It is a warm afternoon, and Nina has time off.

sentences.sk: Rozhodne sa ísť so svojím psom do parku.
sentences.en: She decides to go to the park with her dog.

sentences.sk: Pes sa volá Max a má rád dlhé prechádzky.
sentences.en: The dog is called Max, and he likes long walks.

sentences.sk: Nina si vezme vodu, loptu a malú tašku.
sentences.en: Nina takes water, a ball, and a small bag.

sentences.sk: Park je len päť minút od jej domu.
sentences.en: The park is only five minutes from her house.

sentences.sk: Pri vchode vidí veľké stromy a veľa kvetov.
sentences.en: At the entrance she sees large trees and many flowers.

sentences.sk: Deti sa hrajú na ihrisku.
sentences.en: Children are playing on the playground.

sentences.sk: Max chce bežať za loptou, ale Nina ho najprv napojí.
sentences.en: Max wants to run after the ball, but Nina gives him water first.

sentences.sk: Potom mu hodí loptu na trávu.
sentences.en: Then she throws him the ball onto the grass.

sentences.sk: Max beží rýchlo a prinesie loptu späť.
sentences.en: Max runs quickly and brings the ball back.

sentences.sk: Nina sa usmeje a znova mu ju hodí.
sentences.en: Nina smiles and throws it to him again.

sentences.sk: Po chvíli si sadnú do tieňa pod stromom.
sentences.en: After a while they sit in the shade under a tree.

sentences.sk: Nina počuje vtáky a číta si krátky článok.
sentences.en: Nina hears birds and reads a short article.

sentences.sk: Vedľa nej sedí pán s malým bielym psom.
sentences.en: A man with a small white dog sits next to her.

sentences.sk: Obaja sa rozprávajú o svojich psoch.
sentences.en: They both talk about their dogs.

sentences.sk: Pán povie, že do parku chodí každý deň.
sentences.en: The man says he comes to the park every day.

sentences.sk: Max a biely pes sa spolu pokojne hrajú.
sentences.en: Max and the white dog play together calmly.

sentences.sk: Keď sa začne stmievať, Nina ide domov.
sentences.en: When it starts getting dark, Nina goes home.

sentences.sk: Max je unavený, ale vyzerá spokojne.
sentences.en: Max is tired, but he looks content.

sentences.sk: Nina mu doma pripraví večeru a čerstvú vodu.
sentences.en: At home Nina prepares dinner and fresh water for him.

glossary.note: Neuter noun; free time away from work.
Here she gives water to her dog.
Accusative plural of masculine noun vták; it is the object of počuje.
Here, vyzerá spokojne means he looks content.

questions.explanationEn: She goes home when it begins to get dark.
